fusions.name: Clouded Shallows
fusions.desc: Kicks up the bottom mud in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 3 damage with a 35% chance to leave each enemy [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Silt Burial
fusions.desc: Drops a mass of riverbed silt on the first enemy it meets for 30 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Mud Wallow
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Riverbed Ballast
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
